subject: Architecture
title: Mid-Century Modern: Elegance for Everyone
description: A fast breakdown of Mid-Century Modern: Elegance for Everyone for builders.

hook.text: After World War II, Americans wanted modern homes — and architects made them affordable for the first time.

buildup.text: Open floor plans, large windows, flat roofs, and indoor-outdoor living defined the mid-century style.

discovery.text: The Eames House in Los Angeles was built from off-the-shelf industrial parts in just two days of assembly.

twist.text: Palm Springs became the capital of mid-century modern — now tourists flock there for architecture tours.

climax.text: IKEA, Target, and West Elm all sell mid-century-inspired furniture. The style never really went away.

punchline.text: They designed for the masses. Seventy years later, it's still selling.

quiz.question: What was special about the construction of the Eames House?
options: It was carved into a hillside like a cave
It was assembled from off-the-shelf industrial parts
It was the first house with solar panels
